help.goal: Three acts, each a board of chips: fights, elites, events, shops, the Cooling Bay and caches. Beat the act boss to go deeper. Win a run to open the next Ascension.
help.heat: A Forge Burst deals {{base}} plus {{per}} per Heat to every enemy and spends the Heat. Or Vent once a turn: {{vent}} Block per Heat.
help.intents: Enemies show what they will do. Weak hits for less, Vulnerable takes more, Bleed loses HP each turn, Frail gains less Block, a Jammed enemy skips its move. Armor reduces every hit. Phased enemies take half from off-phrase cards.
help.keys: 1 to 9 play a card. V vents. E ends the turn. Q changes target. Tab and Enter work everywhere.
help.phrase: Each turn the signal shows a phrase of waveforms. A card whose waveform matches the next slot lands on the phrase: it is multiplied and builds Heat. Finish the phrase to fire a Forge Burst at every enemy.
help.static: Each card played off the phrase adds 1 Static. When Static fills up it overloads: a Glitch card enters your discard for the rest of the fight.
help.timing: Timed: play on the beat. Perfect x{{p}} and 2 Heat, Good x{{g}}, Late x1. Steady: no clock, every on-phrase card counts as Good (x{{g}}). Pick either when you start a run.
help.title: How to play

menu.tagline: Land the phrase. Bank the heat. Fire the forge.
menu.timed-text: Play to the beat: Perfect hits hardest. Sound helps.
